description: This file defines an interface 'MetadataStrategyInterface' within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifying methods for saving and loading encryption metadata strategies.

classes.name: MetadataStrategyInterface
classes.description: An interface that outlines strategies for handling encryption metadata, including methods 'save' and 'load'.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Stores encryption metadata into a strategy-specific location and updates arguments for the PutObject operation.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Creates a MetadataEnvelope from provided arguments, typically containing S3 object information and headers.
